-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.NodeApiVocab` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def Draft.NodeDriverState.init (stor : Storage) : Draft.NodeDriverState :=
  { storage := stor, delivered := [], hardState := hsZero, handling := none }

def Draft.instDecidableIsFiller (e : Draft.LogEntry) : Decidable e.isFiller :=
  id inferInstance

def Draft.LogEntry.toEntryM (idx : w64) (e : Draft.LogEntry) : EntryM :=
  { Term' := e.term, Index' := idx, Type' := e.type, Data' := e.data }

def Draft.LogEntry.isFiller (e : Draft.LogEntry) : Prop :=
  e.data = [] ∧ (e.type = W32 0 ∨ e.type = W32 2)

def Draft.opsOf (l : List Draft.LogEntry) : List Draft.LogEntry :=
  List.filter (fun e => !decide e.isFiller) l

def Draft.committedEntriesAt (sl : GoSlice) (base : Nat) (ce : List Draft.LogEntry) : IProp GF :=
  entsRO sl (Draft.LogEntry.toEntries ce base)

theorem Draft.committedEntriesAt_persistent (sl : GoSlice) (base : Nat) (ce : List Draft.LogEntry) :
    Persistent (Draft.committedEntriesAt sl base ce)

def Draft.BootLog (ps : List w64) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (boot : List Draft.LogEntry) : Prop :=
  boot.length = ps.length ∧
    ↑boot.length < 2 ^ 61 ∧
      ∀ (k : Nat) (e : Draft.LogEntry),
        boot[k]? = some e →
          ∃ id ctx,
            ps[k]? = some id ∧
              ctxs[k]? = some ctx ∧
                e.term = W64 1 ∧
                  e.type = W32 1 ∧
                    MarshalsConfChange
                      (some (ConfChangeIM.v1 { type := W32 0, nodeId := id, context := ctx, id := W64 0 })) e.data

structure Draft.LogEntry : Type where
  term : w64
  type : raftpb.EntryType
  data : List w8

def Draft.LogEntry.toEntries (l : List Draft.LogEntry) (base : Nat) : List EntryM :=
  List.mapIdx (fun i e => Draft.LogEntry.toEntryM (W64 (↑base + ↑i + 1)) e) l

structure Draft.NodeDriverState : Type where
  storage : Storage
  delivered : List Draft.LogEntry
  hardState : HardStateM
  handling : Option (List EntryM × Option SnapLoan)
